title: mesh-bus-scheduler-cake
description: CAKE-based metadata-only exit ranking scheduler. Consumes RankContext placement metadata and local measurement windows; never parses protocol payloads.

RankContextUse.description: Packet metadata consumed by the scheduler before ranking candidates.

flow_id.description: Used as the deterministic ranking key.

flow_semantics.description: L4 flow-shape metadata available for generic transport placement; not a protocol parser or L7 policy input.

return_semantics.description: L4 return-shape metadata available for generic transport placement; not a protocol parser or L7 policy input.

ExitMetric.description: Per-exit metrics fed into the CAKE rank function.

ScheduleDecision.description: Decision shape returned by the CAKE scheduler.

mode.description: CAKE only orders candidates; bus-core owns Replicate fan-out semantics.
